description: This file defines the LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering leave type search results within the Leave module of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, adds a 'name' property with getter and setter, and initializes default sorting behavior.

classes.name: LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for filtering leave type search results, allowing filtering by name and setting default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with the default sort field 'leaveType.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter parameter.
